title: POS Payment Methods
description: Configure cash, card, and other till payment methods.

help.title: About payment methods
help.overview: Each payment method is one button on the till: cash or card. Each till chooses which ones it offers, and the sequence sets their order.

sections.title: Cash and card
items: Cash: quick amounts are one-tap buttons, such as 5, 10, 20, separated by commas. Cash payments and change are counted in the drawer.
Card without a terminal: the cashier takes the card on a separate machine and records the payment.
Card with a terminal: the till asks the cashier to confirm on it (manual), or sends it the amount and waits for the answer (local HTTP). Test terminal connection checks it answers.

sections.title: Switching off
items: Deactivate hides a method from the till. A till must keep at least one method, so a till's last one can't be deactivated or deleted.
